subject: SAML sign-in fails after certificate change
resolution_summary: Uploaded the new identity provider certificate in SSO settings and tested with one user.

subject: Charged for removed seats
resolution_summary: Confirmed seat removal date against the invoice and raised a prorated refund for approval.

subject: 429 errors during bulk export
resolution_summary: Added exponential backoff using the Retry-After header and lowered concurrency.

subject: Uploads blocked at quota
resolution_summary: Emptied trash, removed old versions and offered a storage add-on.

subject: External share option disabled
resolution_summary: A workspace admin enabled external sharing and granted the member the editor role.

subject: Slack notifications stopped
resolution_summary: Reauthorized the Slack connection after its token was revoked.

subject: Locked out of MFA
resolution_summary: Verified identity, then an admin reset the MFA enrolment.

subject: Calendar view request
resolution_summary: Logged the request with product and explained there is no committed date.
